tools.name: send_campaign_test_email
tools.description: Sends a test copy of a campaign to a recipient address and records the test send in the campaign's history log.

params.name: campaign_id
params.description: ID of the campaign to test

params.name: recipient_email
params.description: Address that receives the test email

tools.code:
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from email.message import EmailMessage

DB_PATH = "marketing.db"


@function_tool
def send_campaign_test_email(campaign_id: int, recipient_email: str) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    subject, html = conn.execute(
        "SELECT subject, html_body FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?", (campaign_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["Subject"] = "[TEST] " + subject
    msg["From"] = "marketing@example.com"
    msg["To"] = recipient_email
    msg.set_content(html, subtype="html")
    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.example.com", 587) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.send_message(msg)
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO campaign_history (campaign_id, event, detail) VALUES (?, 'test_sent', ?)",
        (campaign_id, recipient_email),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return {"campaign_id": campaign_id, "sent_to": recipient_email, "status": "test_sent"}

tools.name: build_campaign_segment
tools.description: Creates a new audience segment for a campaign by selecting subscribers matching the given filters, and stores the segment and its members.

params.name: tag
params.description: Only include subscribers with this tag

params.name: country
params.description: Only include subscribers from this country code

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

DB_PATH = "marketing.db"


def build_campaign_segment(
    segment_name: str,
    tag: str = None,
    min_engagement_score: int = None,
    country: str = None,
    exclude_unsubscribed: bool = True,
) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    clauses = []
    args = []
    if exclude_unsubscribed:
        clauses.append("s.unsubscribed = 0")
    if tag:
        clauses.append("EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscriber_tags t WHERE t.subscriber_id = s.id AND t.tag = ?)")
        args.append(tag)
    if min_engagement_score is not None:
        clauses.append("s.engagement_score >= ?")
        args.append(min_engagement_score)
    if country:
        clauses.append("s.country = ?")
        args.append(country)
    where = (" WHERE " + " AND ".join(clauses)) if clauses else ""
    rows = conn.execute("SELECT s.id FROM subscribers s" + where, args).fetchall()
    member_ids = [r["id"] for r in rows]

    created_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    cur = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO segments (name, created_at, member_count) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
        (segment_name, created_at, len(member_ids)),
    )
    segment_id = cur.lastrowid
    conn.executemany(
        "INSERT INTO segment_members (segment_id, subscriber_id) VALUES (?, ?)",
        [(segment_id, sid) for sid in member_ids],
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

    result = {
        "segment_id": segment_id,
        "name": segment_name,
        "member_count": len(member_ids),
        "created_at": created_at,
        "filters": {
            "tag": tag,
            "min_engagement_score": min_engagement_score,
            "country": country,
            "exclude_unsubscribed": exclude_unsubscribed,
        },
    }
    return result

tools.description: Updates a subscriber's email frequency and topic preferences in the subscriber database.

params.name: email_frequency
params.description: New frequency such as daily, weekly, or monthly

params.name: topics
params.description: List of topic names the subscriber wants

tools.code:
import json
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

DB_PATH = "marketing.db"


def update_subscriber_preferences(subscriber_id: int, email_frequency: str, topics: list) -> dict:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    current_timestamp_in_utc_format = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    serialized_topic_list_for_storage = json.dumps(sorted(set(topics)))
    cursor_for_preference_update = database_connection.execute(
        "UPDATE subscribers SET email_frequency = ?, topics = ?, preferences_updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (
            email_frequency,
            serialized_topic_list_for_storage,
            current_timestamp_in_utc_format,
            subscriber_id,
        ),
    )
    number_of_rows_changed_by_update = cursor_for_preference_update.rowcount
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    return {
        "updated": number_of_rows_changed_by_update > 0,
        "subscriber_id": subscriber_id,
    }
